scope: Two explicitly identified public metal-growth density profiles execute with exact integer areas, independently declared bounds and inclusive 700/70 um windows. Clipped windows remain diagnostic. All 411 tests per OS pass; 27 control layouts and reports and three reference measurements agree byte for byte. Unmodified upstream runs expose omitted endpoint windows and asymmetric boundary clipping, explained independently by rectangle arithmetic. Three Linux application runs and Windows saved-result/export replays pass. APB has 21/10 clipped-window findings under the two profiles; counter/UART have zero. All references are smaller than 700 um, so none obtains full-window acceptance. The 302 unresolved catalog records, pin-spacing definition, final-mask/density applicability and foundry signoff remain open. No new extraction, timing or equivalence is claimed.

oxide_density.scope: Public Tiny Tapeout metal-growth density observations, using drawn metal and native fill on four layers. The first profile uses the upstream checker values; the second uses the values attributed to SkyWater in its comments, not a separately authenticated foundry specification. Integer 80% comparisons are made on full 700 um windows every 70 um from the explicitly declared lower-left corner. Exact endpoint windows are included. Clipped edge windows are diagnostics only. Geometry is grown before clipping, preserving external contributors, holes, hierarchy and overlapping unions. A small block never gets a vacuous pass. These measurements do not establish complete-chip context, final-mask construction, the applicability of this newer 80% profile to the pinned PDK, or m5/ViaTop policy. No catalog disposition or tapeout qualification is changed.

upstream.findings: 700um: original omits all full windows. 770um: original omits endpoint windows. 800um: original uses a centered 840um tile grid and clips denominator to the frame but not numerator; the recorded difference is explained by independent rectangle arithmetic.
upstream.comparison_precision: Upstream KLayout log emits density to four decimal places; compare at that precision. Exact integer-area controls are independent.
